scripts.test:coverage: bun run test:coverage:bun && bun run test:coverage:python
scripts.test:coverage:python: uv run --locked --project scraper coverage run --rcfile=scraper/pyproject.toml -m unittest discover -s scraper/tests -v && uv run --locked --project scraper coverage report --rcfile=scraper/pyproject.toml && uv run --locked --project scraper coverage html --rcfile=scraper/pyproject.toml && uv run --locked --project scraper coverage json --rcfile=scraper/pyproject.toml
scripts.format: prettier --write . --ignore-unknown && uv run --locked --project scraper ruff format scraper
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . --ignore-unknown && uv run --locked --project scraper ruff format --check scraper

scripts.check:python: uv run --locked --project scraper ruff check scraper
scripts.test:python: uv run --locked --project scraper python -m unittest discover -s scraper/tests -v
scripts.test:browser: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.browsers uv run --locked --project scraper python -m scraper.tests.browser_check
